description: Shared Renovate preset for bcit-tlu repos.
All minor + patch updates (any ecosystem) are batched into a single PR
(branch renovate/all-minor-patch) that Renovate keeps force-updating in
place until it is merged or closed. Major updates get one PR each.
Updates are held until a release is 7 days old (supply-chain safety).
Vulnerability alerts are disabled (GITHUB_TOKEN cannot read Dependabot alerts).
